features.title: Modules move to top-level modules/
features.user_visible_behavior: Kit modules live in modules/ next to tools/; the installer, versions, package, CI, and the spec-drift adapter lookup use it; adopters see no change.
verification: cd tools/spec-drift && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && node --import tsx --test test/audit.e2e-spec.ts
